interventions.detail: Installed torch==2.13.0+cpu/torchvision from the PyTorch CPU index instead of the default CUDA build
Installed triton==3.7.1; the remote code imports it and transformers check_imports refuses to load the model without it
modeling_unlimitedocr.py: cast the hard-coded bf16 image tensors to the model dtype so float32 inference works
modeling_unlimitedocr.py: replaced hard-coded .cuda() on images_seq_mask with .to(inputs_embeds.device)
deepencoder.py: compute SAM rel-pos attention in query chunks to avoid OOM on a 16GB CPU box with float32 weights
Pinned the HF model revision, cleared the stale transformers_modules cache after patching, and set HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1 so the patched code is used
